semiconductor_relevance: High — Panasonic Connect provides advanced equipment and technologies essential for both front-end and back-end semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Panasonic Connect specializes in manufacturing and supplying equipment for semiconductor processes, including plasma dicing, dry etching, and wafer cleaning. Their technologies enhance device manufacturing efficiency and quality across various applications, including power devices and MEMS.
capabilities: Plasma dicing equipment for clean processing of non-volatile materials
Dry etching equipment for compound material processing
Plasma cleaners for surface modification of substrates
